en: A vintage illustrated postcard with multiple vignette scenes of a historic European city, featuring parks, ruins, a tower, streets with horse‑drawn carriages, and surrounding countryside. Decorative flowers frame the images. Large stylized text reads "GROETE uit NIJMEGEN," suggesting it is a greeting from the city of Nijmegen. Individual scenes are labeled in Dutch, including a ruin, parks, a railway street, and views of nearby areas.
